Hi Maya / Sam —

Great — happy to run this. Proposed plan:
- 90-min kickoff: product walkthrough, success criteria, prompt set review (we’ll bring a template for prompt evaluation).
- 2-hr working session: hands-on prompt tuning, routing policy walkthrough, and a short 30-minute load test (can be scaled).

Windows we can support next week (all ET):
- Tue 2027-06-08 10:00–13:00 ET (kickoff + working session back-to-back)
- Wed 2027-06-09 13:00–16:00 ET (alternate)

Regarding Hosted vs Dedicated:
- Hosted trial: fastest to start, default quota ~50 rps with 1.5M token/day soft budget, faster iteration. Good for validating prompts and basic routing.
- Dedicated trial: reserved capacity, predictable throughput; we can provision a Dedicated slot for short trials but requires a 24–48 hour provisioning window and a committed quota. Better if you need sustained 100+ rps during load tests.

For the load test we typically ask customers to specify: target RPS, average tokens per request, peak concurrency. Example ask: 150 rps, 600 avg tokens/request → ~54M tokens/hour; we’d want to set a token budget and possibly a rate-limit bump. If that’s too high we can run stepped load (25/50/100/150 rps) across 30-minute windows.

Attaching a draft agenda and a capacity matrix we’ll fill in with your numbers.

Action items for Acuity before kickoff:
- Confirm preferred window (one of the two above)
- Send a small sample of 10 prompts for prompt-evaluation prep
- Indicate desired peak RPS and avg tokens per request for the load test
- If security/compliance folks need to join, share their contact for a parallel SOC 2 checklist review

Thanks — I’ll hold Tue 10:00–13:00 ET tentatively for now.

—Alex
